references.name: neuro-sdk
references.purpose: Defines the Neuro API contract: which websocket messages and fields are valid (API/SPECIFICATION.md), plus API/BEST_PRACTICES.md and PROPOSALS.md. Consult it to decide whether a message, action schema or field is legal. Where BEST_PRACTICES.md prose disagrees with the live-tested behavior of Neuro-Skyrim-Integration, Skyrim wins on behavior; this repo still wins on what is valid. Not the project's C transport: that is the libs/libneurosdk submodule.
references.caveat: Copyright Vedal AI 2024. Preserve the copyright and permission notice in copied substantial portions.

references.name: Neuro-Skyrim-Integration
references.purpose: Behavioral reference for Neuro-facing feature design: what to send to Neuro, when, how often, and when to suppress it (context content, poking/hinting, timing, per-menu action sets). Live-tested on stream. Source is in src/*Processor.cpp (one per menu or feature), script_sources/ (Papyrus) and docs/. Idea source only, not a code source: it targets Skyrim SE 1.6.1170 with SKSE and its script layer, so none of its engine mechanisms carry over to xNVSE. Invoke the skyrim-feature-port skill before using it.
references.targets: Skyrim SE 1.6.1170 (SKSE); not Fallout: New Vegas
references.caveat: Copyright vituha230 2026. The license would permit copying, but project policy (CLAUDE.md, 'Designing features from the Skyrim integration') makes this an idea source only: extract behavior and reasoning, do not copy code or mirror structure.

references.name: FalloutNVAccess
references.purpose: xNVSE screen-reader accessibility plugin for FNV. Contains reverse-engineered engine classes, layouts and offsets, plus concrete menu observation, inventory/Pip-Boy reading, dialogue and character-creation handling (start in src/). Consult it first for how a menu's tiles are read at runtime. Its README targets Vanilla UI Plus, so its tile paths may not exist in vanilla or other UI overhauls.
references.targets: FNV 1.4.0.525 via xNVSE; menu code assumes Vanilla UI Plus
references.caveat: Copyright Alexander Epaneshnikov 2026. Preserve the notice in copied substantial portions; adapted definitions here are credited in src/defs/FalloutNVAccess-license.md. The revision is served by git.alex19ep.me. The former GitHub mirror (FalloutAccess/FalloutNVAccess) was not shown to contain this revision, so it is no longer used.

references.name: itr-nvse
references.purpose: xNVSE plugin bundling engine fixes, gameplay tweaks, UI quality-of-life features and script commands/event hooks (see FEATURES.md). Consult it for engine hook, input and pathfinding patterns and for dialogue, radio, combat and VATS utilities. It is the provenance of this project's adapted src/itr/. Closer to gameplay logic than FalloutNVAccess, which is closer to menu reading.
references.caveat: Copyright Into the Rough contributors 2026. THIRD_PARTY.md lists code with other origins (PerlinNoise.hpp MIT, VATSSpeechFix ported from SoundFilteringSoftware, RefillAmmo based on ShowOff-NVSE, a bundled modified NVSE 5.1.4 SDK with its own licence). Check THIRD_PARTY.md and the file before copying anything; preserve src/itr/itr-license.md.

references.name: JIP-LN-NVSE
references.purpose: JIP-LN NVSE plugin: 1000+ script functions and engine fixes (functions_jip/, functions_ln/, internal/, nvse/). Consult it for how an engine function is called, inventory and extra-data handling, UI/script commands and reverse-engineered call patterns. Largest source of engine call evidence; cross-check against JohnnyGuitarNVSE.
references.caveat: LICENSE is the GPLv3 text; 'or later' wording was not found in the repository, so only GPL-3.0 is recorded. Copyleft applies to derivative works: do not adapt code without reviewing compatibility with this project's license first.

references.name: JohnnyGuitarNVSE
references.purpose: JohnnyGuitar NVSE plugin: script functions, features and engine fixes (JG/, shared/). Source of the JG definitions already compiled here via libs/nvse/JG. Consult it for expanded Bethesda/Gamebryo class declarations, inventory/UI helpers and plugin command patterns, and to check this project's JG definitions against upstream.
references.caveat: README states LGPLv2.1-only. Preserve notices and comply with LGPL conditions when adapting or distributing; review compatibility before copying.

references.name: NVSE
references.purpose: xNVSE runtime and plugin API: interfaces, plugin lifecycle, engine type declarations, script command implementation, nvse_plugin_example/. Consult it for the authoritative plugin API and message types. Compare with the vendored libs/nvse first; upstream may be newer than the vendored copy.
references.license: No top-level license. common/ has Ian Patterson's zlib-style license (common/common_license.txt, covers common/ only); nvse/Algohol/ is MIT; nothing else is licensed.
references.caveat: Reference only. The license is missing for the main source, so it is not copyable; the bundled common/ and Algohol licenses cover only those directories.

references.name: yUI-NVSE
references.purpose: yvileapsis's NVSE plugins (yUI/, CommonLib/, CrashLogger/, nvse/). Consult it for inventory sorting and icons, tile/UI integration, and alternative engine definitions. Its UI code modifies menus, so check whether a behavior is a mod change rather than vanilla.
references.caveat: Reference only. README says it borrows liberally from lStewieAl's Tweaks and kNVSE, so provenance is mixed and unlicensed.

references.name: sup
references.purpose: SUP NVSE plugin: HUD bar and tile manipulation, utility and UI commands (Tomm_fn_UI.h; start in nvse_plugin_example/). Consult it only when tile or HUD manipulation evidence is missing from FalloutNVAccess and yUI-NVSE.
references.license: No license for the plugin. The bundled common/ carries Ian Patterson's license, which covers only that directory.
references.caveat: The revision is the public New2 branch head (2021), used only when cloning fresh. A local copy in .references may be unversioned and newer; `check` reports it as non-git. decoding.h says it was copied from JIP-LN-NVSE (GPL). Reference only: do not copy.

menu_data.archive_policy: ZIP must contain only menus/**/*.xml files; total uncompressed payload <= 64 MiB, each XML <= 4 MiB and compression ratio <= 200; traversal, backslashes, symlinks and invalid ZIP structure are rejected.
menu_data.privacy: Private menu archives and extracted XML are local-only and are not committed.
